reason: Existing createDraft binds only to live state; preview accepts a mutable authored draft plus one operation. Copying a frozen preview into that draft conflates issued derived output with raw writes. Omitting derived output instead discards compile/delete intent. A separate issued continuation capability preserves provenance without changing current createDraft/preview/apply behavior or introducing operation replay.
proposedSemantics: Only the issuing controller may continue its exact frozen preview handle; forged, foreign, stale and already-applied handles reject.
New detached continuation draft retains original live project fingerprint and uses the genuine frozen preview as its private ownership checkpoint.
No live apply, history write, fabricated baseline or guard bypass on continuation.
Subsequent authored changes compare protected fields against the checkpoint; aggregate impact compares final output against the original unchanged live project.
Existing public createDraft, preview and apply signatures and semantics remain unchanged; helper edit action explicitly obtains the continuation draft.
